findings.interpretation_limit: Absence of gradient update alone does not invalidate heuristic pruning; it prevents treating this code as a trained policy optimizer.

findings.claim: Historical feedback increments every realized spatial edge when final prediction matches gold, rather than measuring each edge's conditional intervention effect.
